findings: STL1 stores only final tree overrides, so its exact historical revision cannot be recovered. The reader uses the documented deterministic lower bound equal to the number of saved tree records.
The test CMake project uses the Visual Studio generator; CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE is ignored, so Release was explicitly selected with `--config Release`.
Host catalog validation and actual host save/load remain root integration responsibilities; this task implements the domain seam only.
assumptions_made: Legacy revision reconstruction counts each persisted tree override once because STL1 did not encode repeated updates to a tree.
HostPose camera mode is represented as an unsigned 8-bit enum value and accepts only values 0, 1, or 2 as specified by the brief.
